vson_p:
# Negation example: a dragon and a knight, but the dragon does NOT perceive
# the knight (the knight is hidden from view).
#
# Demonstrates: Negation node + reified Annotation form for negatedStatement
# (per spec §18 — RDF 1.1 portable equivalent of canonical <<s p o>>;
# both forms conform to vss:NegationShape and vss:AnnotationShape).

(scene / Composition
   :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle low :focalLength 35mm :framing wide_shot)
   :viewedBy cam

   :depicts (knight / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Named :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Human
               :hasQuality (q1 / Quality :dimension Role :value knight))

   :depicts (dragon / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Animal
               :hasQuality (q2 / Quality :dimension Affect :value angry))

   :depicts (neg1 / Negation
               :negatedStatement (n_ann / Annotation
                                    :annotatedSubject dragon
                                    :annotatedPredicate perceives
                                    :annotatedObject knight)))
vson_t:
@prefix vso:   <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#> .
@prefix allen: <https://vson.dev/v1/allen#> .
@prefix rcc:   <https://vson.dev/v1/rcc8#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix :      <https://example.org/scenes/anonymous#> .

:scene a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Composition> .
:cam a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#CameraView> .
:cam <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#angle> "low" .
:cam <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#focalLength> "35mm" .
:cam <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#framing> "wide_shot" .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#framedBy> :cam .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#viewedBy> :cam .
:knight a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#PhysicalObject> .
:knight <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#individuation> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Named> .
:knight <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#animacy> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Agentive> .
:knight <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#countability> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Count> .
:knight <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#class> :Human .
:q1 a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Quality> .
:q1 <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#dimension> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Role> .
:q1 <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#value> :knight .
:knight <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#hasQuality> :q1 .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#depicts> :knight .
:dragon a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#PhysicalObject> .
:dragon <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#individuation> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Generic> .
:dragon <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#animacy> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Agentive> .
:dragon <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#countability> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Count> .
:dragon <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#class> :Animal .
:q2 a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Quality> .
:q2 <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#dimension> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Affect> .
:q2 <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#value> :angry .
:dragon <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#hasQuality> :q2 .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#depicts> :dragon .
:neg1 a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Negation> .
:n_ann a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Annotation> .
:n_ann <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#annotatedSubject> :dragon .
:n_ann <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#annotatedPredicate> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#perceives> .
:n_ann <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#annotatedObject> :knight .
:neg1 <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#negatedStatement> :n_ann .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#depicts> :neg1 .
